text: CIR is an MLIR dialect in Clang between the AST and LLVM IR, enabled with -fclangir. CIRGen mirrors classic codegen on purpose, accepting duplication as debt, and lit tests check both paths' LLVM IR (CodeDuplication.md). Cleanups and EH use cir.cleanup.scope and cir.try, flattened by FlattenCFG and then lowered per ABI (CleanupAndEHDesign.md). Calling conventions go through the LLVM ABI library via ABITypeMapper and ABIRewriteContext (ABILowering.md). Start at clang/docs/CIR/index.md.
